# Spell batch #520 fixtures

The 100 YAML files are byte-identical snapshots of the ticket's pinned roots: 99 Spells and the excluded Enchantment folder. The 28 class files supply unreviewed class-tag context. [Provenance](provenance.json) records their exact paths and hashes; reduced manifests describe these fixture packs only.

[Preview](preview.json) contains parser output with the checked description overlay. All 99 Attribution Assessments remain unresolved. These fixtures establish no legal admission, Catalog Release or deployment. Recording a Spell grants no running Modifiers.

[Public resolver tests](../../catalog/spells-520.test.ts) check literal class-list metadata, complete description bindings, shared Situations and independently outstanding running calculations. [Isolated saved-sheet tests](../../../convex/catalogSpells520.integration.test.ts) exercise Oracle and Wizard collections, member editing, outsider rejection, campaign scope, removal and preview parity. Source-backed Oracle context uses the existing casting table only in memory; it is not an extra reviewed candidate.

[Full-context binding preview](binding-preview.json) is a minimal recursive subset of the fresh verified full-checkout CLI output. It retains all 99 Spell roots, their catalog dependencies and remaps to reproduce every current content/mapping/evidence/notice binding through the public helper. Its extraction hashes match the legal inventory; context entries are unreviewed dependencies and establish no extra admission. The reduced parser preview above is regenerated independently, and all 128 raw source hashes are rechecked against the pinned checkout.
